instruction:
Fix `packages/element/src/delta.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. yarn test:app --watch=false: 31 tests fail, all in packages/excalidraw/tests/history.test.tsx, every one a snapshot mismatch, e.g. `history > singleplayer undo/redo > should end up with no history entry after initializing scene > [end of test] element 1 1` mismatched: `-   "customData": undefined,` (the snapshot expects the own key `customData: undefined`; it is now gone). Snapshots are off-limits and must not change (NFR-2). Cause: the loop added at the end of ElementsDelta.applyDelta (after `const nextElement = newElementWith(element, directlyApplicablePartial, true);`) deletes EVERY key whose applied value is undefined, so it also strips keys like customData that elements legitimately carry as own `undefined` properties. Fix: delete only `arrowheadSize`, and only when the applied partial has the `arrowheadSize` key with value undefined (e.g. `if ("arrowheadSize" in directlyApplicablePartial && directlyApplicablePartial.arrowheadSize === undefined) { delete (nextElement as Mutable<ExcalidrawLinearElement>).arrowheadSize; }`); every other key is applied exactly as before the run. Also revert the round-1 change in applyLatestChanges' applyLatestChangesInternal back to `if (Delta.isInnerDifferent(latestDelta.deleted, latestDelta.inserted))` (the original line): the deleted and inserted partials there always share their key set, so the change is not needed. Undo of arrowheadSize must still clear the key: an arrow created without arrowheadSize, set to 1.5 by actionChangeArrowheadSize, then undone, has `"arrowheadSize" in element === false`; redo restores 1.5.

instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/data/restore.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. yarn test:typecheck: packages/excalidraw/data/restore.ts(540,23): error TS2345: Argument of type 'T & Record<"arrowheadSize", unknown>' is not assignable to parameter of type 'ExcalidrawElement | null | undefined'. ... is missing the following properties from type ExcalidrawArrowElement: points, startBinding, endBinding, startArrowhead, endArrowhead. The site is `if ("arrowheadSize" in ret && (!isLinearElement(ret) || ...)) { delete (ret as any).arrowheadSize; }`: the `in` check narrows `ret` before it is passed to isLinearElement. Keep the behaviour (drop arrowheadSize unless the element is linear and the value is a finite number > 0) but make it type-check, e.g. test `isLinearElement(ret as ExcalidrawElement)` or read the value into a local first (`const arrowheadSize = (ret as { arrowheadSize?: unknown }).arrowheadSize;`) and test `arrowheadSize !== undefined` instead of the `in` narrowing. No other change.
